metadata.title: A Novel Design and Performance Results of An Electrically Tunable Piezoelectric Vibration Energy Harvester (TPVEH)

configuration.quote: One such type of harvester is designed using piezoelectric materials and using a cantilever type set-up.

proof_mass.quote: The novel TPVEH consists of a cantilever beam on which MFC is bonded in the unimorph configuration, and an IPMC actuator integrated into the system.
proof_mass.section: 2.1. Materials Utilized and Design Concept of the Device

length_mm.quote: aluminum cantilever beam that consists of two sections, the 0.64 mm thick root section of 15 cm × 3.5 cm and the 0.37 mm thick extension of 10.5 cm × 2 cm, with an overlap of 3 cm.
length_mm.section: 2.1. Materials Utilized and Design Concept of the Device

frequency_Hz.quote: frequency shift from 5.9 Hz to 8 Hz

motion_source.quote: The cantilever was subjected to vibration at point C using an electrodynamic exciter.
